note: Spencer County publishes zoning via a ThinkGIS web viewer (spencerin.wthgis.com / spencer.in.wthgis.com) that says it has zoning layers, but no ArcGIS REST service or downloadable zoning polygon layer was found there (its /arcgis/rest/services endpoints return 404). The county Plan Commission page offers only zoning definitions and a schedule of uses; no queryable zoning district layer found in ArcGIS Online, Indiana state services, or the county/regional sites. Rockport, Santa Claus and other towns publish only PDF base/aerial maps.
